title: I Worked As A Cranberry Farmer For A Day | Lucie For Hire | Refinery29
description:
This week on Lucie For Hire, our host, Lucie Fink learns how to be a cranberry farmer for the day. At the Ocean Spray bog, she discovers the various varieties of cranberries as well as how to harvest them. Check out the latest episode of Lucie For Hire to see how she does at it! 

ABOUT SERIES
Refinery29's Lucie Fink immerses herself in an assortment of unique and intriguing careers for one day at a time. Each opportunity gives viewers a never-before-seen look into these atypical and fascinating jobs from a new hire's POV.
